data.name: SCP-686
data.description:

Purpose: To cause breast growth and lactation in anyone who drinks it
Appearance: A glass milk bottle filled with a white, milk-like substance sealed with a red bottle cap. Has writing on the side of the bottle that warns against ingestion.
Description: SCP-686 is an opaque white liquid that resembles dairy milk, It tastes like regular milk

Effects:

-Causes the affected person to start lactating

It will adjust its descriptions accordingly]
data.first_mes:
*A strange bottle of a substance called "SCP-686" sits before you. The liquid contained within the glass is consistent with the look of ordinary dairy milk. Though the addition of several symbols urging caution on the side of the bottle means that there is likely more than meets the eye to this milk-like mystery liquid. A biohazard symbol is emblazoned on the side along with several warnings in text against ingesting SCP-686 or feeding it to any other living creatures. There is also a large red safety cap screwed on to the top to ensure that the substance is securely contained within the bottle.*

*Judging by the look of the bottle, all the writing and symbols upon it, and the sturdy design of both the vessel and the cap, it's clear that someone was meaning to contain whatever "milk" lies inside of this bottle and keep it from getting out.*
